title.english: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
title.native: 帝乃三姉妹は案外、チョロい。

synonyms: The Mikadono sisters are surprisingly easy to deal with.
description:
Yuu Ayase, son of a late legendary actress, is overwhelmingly mediocre. When he’s invited to stay with his mother’s friend, Yuu is shocked to find out that he’ll be living with three prodigy sisters who possess both beauty and talent…and who rule his new school as the Three Emperors. Can Yuu manage to melt the sisters’ cold hearts and fulfill his mother’s last wish for him to build a happy family?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Niko is the second eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. Despite her small stature of 150cm, Niko is a karate athlete who overwhelms her opponents with immense strength, winning numerous medals. She has exceptional physical abilities since childhood, dominating various martial arts competitions, and her robust and charismatic personality reflects her strict attitude towards herself and others. However, she also has a shy side and has a tendency to enjoy cute and bright things.

Miwa is the youngest of the Mikadono Sisters. She is a high school girl with a unique two-tone short cut, with the top of her head being blonde and the rest of her hair being green. Like her sisters, she also has golden eyes.

Miwa is a genius shogi player with an IQ exceeding 180, occasionally winning in shogi and chess competitions and leading her team to victory in international mathematics competitions as the youngest female representative. However, her outstanding genius often isolates her from others, as she lacks interest in mundane conversations and people tend to keep their distance from her. Moreover, her genius is predominantly focused on her intellect, so her physical abilities are mediocre compared to Yuu's.

Kazuki is the eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. She possesses outstanding acting and singing skills, capable of flawlessly portraying roles that are deemed impossible by others, and she also has incredible ticket-selling power, as every performance she appears in is sold out. Despite being part of an all-female theater group, she specializes in male roles due to her deep voice and polished appearance, which makes her extremely popular among women as a prince figure. However, she internally feels a compulsion to lead and help others without relying on anyone, in order to live up to her image as everyone's prince. Despite her perfectionist image, she surprisingly has a picky eating habit.

Yuu is a 17-year-old boy with a short stature. He possesses striking red hair and red eyes. Despite being described as average, his most notable feature is his handsome and beautiful face, which he inherited from his mother, Subaru Ayase.

Yuu is a naturally kind and caring boy, always willing to help the Mikadono Sisters and those in need, even if it means butting into their business. He approaches life with extreme positivity and proactivity, often going above and beyond to lend a hand. However, the sisters sometimes see his kindness as a weakness and tease and scold him for it, yet still find it appealing and fascinating.

Since childhood, Yuu has been scorned for being talentless despite being the son of Subaru Ayase. As a result, he is very self-aware of his capabilities and incompetence. Despite his low self-esteem, he strives to excel in housework and cooking, where he can shine. His cooking skills are unrivaled, and he accommodates the sisters' extreme diet choices with ease, much to their astonishment. However, he occasionally pushes himself too hard and ends up getting sick.

Sakura Yaotome is a first-year high schooler and Miwa Mikadono's self-proclaimed rival in shogi. Unlike other shogi players, who became prodigies, Sakura was a novice who only became skilled at the game through hard work and perseverance.

An immensely successful actress, Subaru Ayase was lauded as immensely talented in any field she tried her hand at. Unfortunately, her prestige came at a price, as she was unable to spend time with her son Yuu due to her work. On her deathbed, she asked that Yuu create a happy family where she could not.

Patriarch of the Mikadono household, Mr. Mikadono raised his three daughters under a strict regimen to bring out the best of their abilities. Subaru Ayase is an old friend of his, and because he was indebted to her in the past, he takes in her son Yuu after her passing.
A third year student at Iwayama High, Hayato Tatsumi is known as a genius karateka and Niko Mikadono's senpai.
